title: Release gatekeeper templates & activation scripts (working)
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a living toolbox of gatekeeper templates, activation/rollback scripts, and comms snippets for cross-functional rollouts (canaries / A-B slices).

Why we need this: quick, copy-pasteable artifacts reduce cognitive load and speed the human-in-the-loop decisions during activations. Intended for release stewards, SRE oncall, product PMs, and solutions engineers running early traffic experiments.

Quick start checklist (one-minute skim):
- Pre-activation: create experiment ticket, attach hypothesis, list owner & oncall, declare safety window (UTC), assign steward.
- Infra prep: ensure canary pool capacity >= expected RPS; warm caches; confirm KV cache TTLs.
- Metric baseline: run cohort SQL (below) and snapshot baseline values (latency P95, error rate, task-specific metric).
- Observability: enable dedicated tracing for cohort, add temporary alerts (prometheus snippets below).
- Activation: ramp to 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15–30m stabilization and explicit steward signoff at each step.
- Rollback criteria: error rate > 3x baseline OR P95 latency regression > +300ms OR quality metric degradation > 5% (configurable per feature).

Templates (copy / adapt):
1) Activation metadata template (paste into ticket body):
---
Title: [Feature] Release gate - short description
Owner: NAME (email)
Steward: NAME (pager)
Oncall escalation: team-sre@redwood.ai
Hypothesis: short 1-line measurable outcome (metric & direction)
Start window (UTC): YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM - YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
Initial cohort: 5% randomized by user_id mod 100
Rollout ramps: 5 -> 25 -> 100 (15m stabilization each)
Safety metrics: list (latency_p95_ms, error_rate, top_intent_accuracy)
Rollback thresholds: error_rate > 3x baseline OR latency_p95 +300ms OR top_intent_accuracy drop >5%
---
Notes: include links to dashboards and experiment harness.

2) Sample Prometheus alert rules (temporary, add and remove with activation):
# copy into ops-alerts temp-group
- alert: ReleaseGate_ErrorRateSpike
  expr: increase(http_requests_total{job=\"console-api\",route=~\"/v1/feature/.*\"}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total{job=\"console-api\"}[5m]) > 0.03
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Release gate error rate spike for {{ $labels.route }}"

- alert: ReleaseGate_Latency_P95_Regression
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"console-api\"}[5m])) by (le, route)) > 0.3
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "P95 latency > 300ms for release gate route"

3) Example cohort baseline query (Postgres / analytics):
-- adjust table/column names for your project
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT user_id, last_7d_requests
  FROM user_usage
  WHERE tenant_id = '{{tenant_id}}'
)
SELECT
  count(distinct user_id) AS users,
  avg(latency_ms) AS avg_latency,
  percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_latency,
  sum(case when intent_correct then 1 else 0 end)::float / count(*) AS accuracy
FROM request_events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM cohort);

4) Template Slack activation message (channel: #releases):
@here Starting release gate for *{{feature_name}}*
Owner: {{owner}} | Steward: {{steward}} | Window: {{start}} - {{end}} UTC
Cohort: {{cohort_desc}} | Initial: 5%
Dashboards: {{dash_url}}
Next update at T+15m (steward will post stabilization verdict).
If paging: @oncall-sre (see runbook).

5) Automation snippet: curl -> Redwood Console API to shift traffic (example, replace tokens):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/traffic -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "feature": "{{feature_name}}",
  "traffic_allocation": [{"variant": "control","pct": 95},{"variant":"treatment","pct":5}],
  "note": "canary ramp 5pct"
}'

6) Guarded rollback play (one-liner for SRE):
# incrementally shift all treatment traffic back to control and disable model variant
./scripts/shift-traffic.sh --feature {{feature_name}} --to-control --reason "auto-rollback: {{metric}} exceeded"

7) Steward sign-off matrix (minimal table for ticket):
- Go/no-go 5% -> (steward)
- 25% ramp decision -> (pm + steward + sres)
- 100% final -> (pm exec signoff)

Observability checklist (what to glance at during stabilization):
- Latency distribution (p50, p95, p99) across cohorts
- Error taxonomy (4xx vs 5xx, top three error messages)
- Business quality signal (intent accuracy, conversion, completion rate)
- Cost signal (GPU/host provisioning unexpected surge)
- Traces: sample slow traces and tail latencies

Common failure modes & quick mitigations:
- Injection of noisy queries during canary: pause ramp, collect synthetic queries for repro, unblock when noise subsides.
- Dependency cold-start: warm downstream caches, increase concurrency limits temporarily.
- Gradual drift in quality only: reduce to previous stable model variant and schedule immediate triage with applied-ml.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Add one-click dashboard templates for all major product areas (PMs to own widgets).
- Lock in standard default thresholds per product vertical (search vs chat vs reranking).
- Automate temporary alert teardown after window expiration.

Appendix: quick variable list for templates
- {{feature_name}}: internal shortname
- {{owner}}: primary owner
- {{steward}}: operations steward (pager)
- {{dash_url}}: link to release dashboard
- {{cohort_desc}}: how cohort is selected (eg quota bucket, random by user id mod)

Notes to self (chaotic, please clean):
- Keep ramp windows conservative for latency-sensitive paths (recommend 30m).
- Prefer randomization by stable identifier to prevent exposure bias.
- When in doubt, prefer human-in-the-loop (safety over velocity).

If you copy any of these snippets into a ticket, please add a short post-activation retrospective line: "what surprised us" + "next action".

End of doc.
summary: Working kit: gatekeeper templates, alert snippets, SQL cohort baseline, slack copy, automation examples, steward signoff matrix, checklist and open TODOs for release stewards and SREs.
